known_limitations: Security-review handoff (not performed by this task). Precondition: the orchestrator delegates the ADR-025 clause 6 endpoint/panel security review to the security-reviewer after this worker report. Consequence: until docs/implementation/17.4/security-review.json is recorded, Gate 17's 'security review recorded with no open BLOCKER/HIGH' condition is unmet; the canonical docs and this report only name the path and no verdict is asserted. state.json task 17.4 reports lists the worker report only; adding the security-review path when it lands follows the task 15.4 convention (both paths in reports).

The panel's inline JavaScript is not executed by the suite or the documented live matrix. Precondition: the repository deliberately has no JavaScript runtime, this environment has none, and the pinned live matrix runs --nowebclient. Consequence: the fetch, DOM construction, rejection path, and fail-closed no-data rendering are pinned structurally against the endpoint model and the pinned bundled web-client source; a runtime/browser behavior change in ApiClient.ajax or the page script would not be caught by the suite in this phase.

The endpoint's live host-side authorization is not confirmed in this environment. Precondition: ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is unset. Behaviour: the default suite skips ArrTags.Tests.DiagnosticsStatusEndpointTests.EndpointUsesThePinnedHostAdministratorGatingPolicy (one of the 64 skips), while the in-process MVC pipeline tests cover anonymous 401, authenticated non-administrator 403, and authenticated administrator 200. Consequence: the pinned-host policy equality is not re-verified here; the v1.2 plan assigns pinned-host live verification (including the status endpoint) to Phase 21 task 21.4, and that matrix runs --nowebclient, so it does not execute the panel's JavaScript either.

Register decision: no accepted-limitation ID was registered for the two residuals above (see interpretations). If the security or phase reviewer judges the structural-only panel verification a standing limitation, adding e.g. V12-F3-1 to docs/limitations/accepted.md plus the index and state.json.limitations.accepted remains an orchestrator/reviewer follow-up; the honest statements already exist in the archive entry, the ADR-025 note, and the changelog.

The counters are process-lifetime only: they reset on restart and are never persisted, so the surface reports current process state and no durable history, per-item listing, or export. This is the accepted ADR-025 shape, not a defect of this task.
